## Notes & caveats (not failures)

- The map's **LOC** column uses line-count (`count("\n")+1`), 1 higher than
  `wc -l`. Consistent and within tolerance; no action needed.
- The map's **public-API count** is the count of real dual-API exports and
  correctly omits the `window.CL` namespace boilerplate. Don't compare it
  against a raw `grep -c 'window'`.
- Tab→function association in the Function Index is **heuristic** (name/body
  keyword match). The spot-check did not stress this; many functions are tagged
  `shared` when no tab keyword matched (e.g. `paintFSCombinedHourChart`,
  `showLocationDetail` — both genuinely belong to a tab but lacked a matching
  keyword). This is a known, documented limitation, not drift: locations are
  accurate; only the tab label is approximate. Verify scope before relying on
  the `Tab(s)` column.
